== Title ==
<span lang="ja">LIN-V8M (エライン・ヴィーエイテム)</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">地雷を敷設できる。また、ターン中の好きな時に、1フォース消費して同じ位置カードにある地雷を1つ“無効化”（ロスト）させられる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">地雷の敷設を専門とする、軍用の装甲ドロイド。元来は鉱脈やスパイス鉱山に爆薬を仕掛けるためのものだが、軍用に改造されている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)]].

'''Lore''' — An armored military droid that specializes in laying mines. Originally it was meant to plant explosives in ore veins and spice mines, but it has been converted for military use.

'''Game text''' — May lay mines. Also, at any time during a turn, may spend 1 Force to “disable” (lose) one mine at the same location card.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Title kana is エライン・ヴィーエイテム, not the Light LIN-V8K エルアイン・ヴィーエイトケイ. Lore names ore veins and spice mines (鉱脈やスパイス鉱山). Game text matches LIN-V8K: また, 位置カード, and “無効化”.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-linv8m-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)]].</ref>
